turns.text: Bholi presentation cha. Malai shanta huna madat gara.

output.message: Ekchhin aafno dhyan presentation bata hataera, aafno khutta bhuimā majjale teknus. Ani aafno waripari herera aakhale dekhne kunai tin ota kura dhyan diyera hernus ta. K k dekhirakhnu bhayeko cha?

turns.user: Saas ko exercise le malai chakkar lagcha. Tyo nagarau.

output.message: Huss, saas ko exercise nagarau. Aafno cheu-chhauko kunai thos kura samatnus—jastai table wa aafno luga. Tesko chiso-taato ra chhuwada kasto anubhuti hunchha, ekchhin tesko banotmai matra dhyan lagaunus.
Bujhe. Ris bhayera haina, bholi presentation huda kura haru almal parirakheko cha. Aile sabai bhanda dherai k kura le almal banairacha?
Huss, kunai sallah didina. J kura aaiiraheko cha bhandai janus, ma suniraheko chu.
